facts.fact: IRBE7, citing Attijari Bank's first-quarter 2025 report, says a bank consortium led by Attijari granted Ooredoo a TND 310 million syndicated loan that let it acquire its 5G licence in December 2024 and deploy its national 5G network.
IRBE7 reports the TND 310 million syndicated loan to Ooredoo for 5G was led by Attijari Bank Tunisie, as lead of a bank consortium.
